profile.tagline: Software Engineering Student | Founding Engineer at PilotMVP | Full Stack Developer
profile.bio: Architecting cutting-edge web applications with the MERN stack. Specializing in high-performance, scalable solutions that push the boundaries of modern web development.
profile.aboutLead: A passionate full-stack developer with a mission to build the future of web technologies. Specializing in rapid prototyping, scalable architecture, and user-centric design.
aboutStory: My journey into software development began during university, where I discovered my passion for building applications that solve real-world problems. What started as a curiosity about how websites work evolved into a full-fledged career in web development.

Over the past several years, I've had the privilege of working with innovative startups and established companies, building everything from MVPs to enterprise-scale applications. My focus has always been on creating robust, scalable solutions using modern technologies.

As a Founding Engineer at PilotMVP, I'm currently leading the charge in revolutionizing how startups build and deploy their products. I believe in the power of technology to transform ideas into reality, and I'm committed to making that process as seamless as possible.
